purpose: Escenografía 3D original de portada. El logo real se superpone sin modificar en HTML.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: bespoke website hero scene, landscape 3:2. Create an exceptionally elegant photorealistic 3D architectural identity display for a Peruvian software developer's personal portfolio, in graphite black, deep burgundy and restrained red neon. Scene: a freestanding sculptural asymmetrical portal made from thick blackened machined metal, ruby glass insets and thin red emissive edge lighting, rising from a low elliptical graphite plinth with precise brushed metal bevels and a single luminous scarlet seam. One exquisite small suspended ruby glass sphere on the upper right. Camera slightly elevated, front three-quarter, realistic materials, sophisticated optical reflections, soft cinematic light, soft ground contact shadows, very dark plum-black studio environment #100d15. Composition: create the sculpture around the OUTER sides and lower edge of the composition; leave the broad CENTRAL 55% of the frame dark, calm and empty for an existing red monogram to be overlaid later in code. Keep every visible object inside the frame and leave generous breathing room. The neon must be a thin accent with rich material depth and excellent edge detail. Editorial luxury technology art direction, precise, refined, original, tactile, physically based rendering. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no interface, no people, no sci-fi tunnel, no repeated generic rings, no busy particles, no excessive bloom, no blue or purple neon.
